    InlineText Value="Introduction"
    Paragraph
      InlineText Value="AsciiDoc supports footnotes."
      InlineFootnote Text="An anonymous footnote"
        InlineText Value="An anonymous footnote"
      InlineText Value=" for inline references."
  Section Id="_details" Level="1" Title="Details"
    InlineText Value="Details"
    Paragraph
      InlineText Value="This uses a named footnote."
      InlineFootnote Id="details" Text="A named footnote"
        InlineText Value="A named footnote"
      InlineText Value=" that can be reused."
    Paragraph
      InlineText Value="See the earlier note."
      InlineFootnote Id="details"
